text:
laura: Build failure on prod: docusaurus throws duplicate anchor for a heading included by both /guides/migration and /guides/migration/legacy. docs-bot: ERROR - Duplicate ID found: 'migration-steps' in 'build/guides/migration/index.html' and 'build/guides/migration/legacy/index.html' toni: This happened because we copied a section into legacy and kept the same H2. Quick fixes: add an explicit html id, or change the heading text slightly. frank: Prefer non-user-visible changes. We can add an HTML anchor right after the heading in the legacy copy: `

Migration steps

` so slug differs. laura: I opened PR #6678 that adds explicit ids for the duplicated headings and normalizes a few relative links that used spaces encoded as `%20`. Local build is clean. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6678 docs-bot: preview available: https://preview.deploy/4832105555-6678 no duplicate anchor warnings toni: Can we add a docs lint to catch `%20` in anchor references? A grep in `scripts/` during PR checks would help. frank: I'll add a small check that fails on `#.*%20` in Markdown links and prints the offending file path. Keeps PR hygiene up. laura: Also noted in the PR description: avoid copying whole sections between guides; prefer includes or reference snippets and let parent pages own headings. Adding that to STYLEGUIDE.md. frank: Pushed the `%20` anchor check in a follow-up commit. laura: Merging once CI finishes. Thanks! :rocket:
